name: ADXL362 ultralow-power 3-axis accelerometer
description: Analog Devices micropower 3-axis MEMS accelerometer, ±2/±4/±8 g, 12-bit (1 mg/LSB on ±2 g), about 2 µA at 100 Hz, with a 4-wire SPI interface (mode 0, 1-5 MHz) and a die temperature sensor. Runs on 1.6-3.5 V; no regulator on the board, so never feed it 5 V. Sold as: SparkFun Triple Axis Accelerometer Breakout - ADXL362 (SEN-11446), two 4-pin headers on opposite edges: V+, GND, INT1, INT2 and CS, MISO, MOSI, SCK.
eli5: Feels which way is down and how hard the board is shaken, while using almost no battery.

pins.name: V+
pins.description: Supply to VS and VDDIO, 1.6-3.5 V (use 3.3 V; no regulator, 5 V destroys it). JP2 pin 1

pins.name: INT1
pins.description: Interrupt 1 output (push-pull to V+), or external clock input; not needed for basic use. JP2 pin 3

pins.name: INT2
pins.description: Interrupt 2 output (push-pull to V+), or external sample trigger; not needed for basic use. JP2 pin 4

pins.name: CS
pins.description: Chip select, active low (printed !CS). JP1 pin 1

pins.name: MISO
pins.description: SPI data out, swings to V+. JP1 pin 2

pins.name: SCK
pins.description: SPI clock, 1-5 MHz recommended, mode 0. JP1 pin 4

supplierQuery: SparkFun ADXL362 triple axis accelerometer breakout SEN-11446
buildNotes: Power V+ from 3.3 V only: the board feeds VS and VDDIO straight from V+ (absolute maximum 3.6 V).
SPI mode 0 (CPOL = CPHA = 0), 1-5 MHz. Read registers with 0x0B <addr>, write with 0x0A <addr> <data>; CS must stay low for the whole transfer.
After reset the chip is in standby and reads 0: write 0x02 to POWER_CTL (0x2D) to start measuring, then wait 4/ODR (40 ms at 100 Hz).
Read X, Y, Z (and temperature) in one burst from 0x0E: 12-bit two's complement, low byte first, sign-extended to 16 bits. 1 mg/LSB on ±2 g.
The two headers are on opposite edges (0.4 in apart), so wire it with jumper leads.
If power is removed, let V+ fall fully to 0 V before re-applying it (datasheet power supply requirements).

driver.code:
# ADXL362 micropower 3-axis accelerometer (Analog Devices), MicroPython driver.
# SPI mode 0 (CPOL = CPHA = 0), 1-5 MHz recommended. Commands per the datasheet:
#   0x0A <addr> <data...>  write register(s)
#   0x0B <addr>            read register(s), address auto-increments
# Data: XDATA_L..ZDATA_H (0x0E-0x13) are 12-bit two's complement values, low byte
# first, sign-extended to 16 bits; TEMP_L/TEMP_H (0x14-0x15) likewise.
from machine import Pin
import time

_WRITE = 0x0A
_READ = 0x0B
_DEVID_AD = 0x00
_XDATA_L = 0x0E
_SOFT_RESET = 0x1F
_FILTER_CTL = 0x2C
_POWER_CTL = 0x2D

_MG_PER_LSB = {2: 1, 4: 2, 8: 4}
_RANGE_BITS = {2: 0x00, 4: 0x40, 8: 0x80}


def _s16(lo, hi):
    v = lo | (hi << 8)
    return v - 0x10000 if v & 0x8000 else v


class ADXL362:
    def __init__(self, spi, cs, g_range=2, odr_bits=0x03):
        """spi: machine.SPI in mode 0; cs: GPIO number of CS. g_range 2, 4 or 8.
        odr_bits 0x03 = 100 Hz (datasheet reset default)."""
        if g_range not in _MG_PER_LSB:
            raise ValueError('g_range must be 2, 4 or 8')
        self.spi = spi
        self.cs = Pin(cs, Pin.OUT, value=1)
        self.g_range = g_range
        self._write(_SOFT_RESET, 0x52)  # 'R': reset, all registers cleared, standby
        time.sleep_ms(10)
        ident = self._read(_DEVID_AD, 3)
        if ident[0] != 0xAD or ident[1] != 0x1D or ident[2] != 0xF2:
            raise OSError('ADXL362 not found (ID %02x %02x %02x): check wiring' % (ident[0], ident[1], ident[2]))
        # FILTER_CTL: range bits [7:6], HALF_BW = 1 (bit 4), ODR [2:0]
        self._write(_FILTER_CTL, _RANGE_BITS[g_range] | 0x10 | (odr_bits & 0x07))
        self._write(_POWER_CTL, 0x02)  # MEASURE = 10: measurement mode, normal noise
        time.sleep_ms(50)  # first valid data after 4/ODR (40 ms at 100 Hz)

    def _write(self, reg, val):
        self.cs.value(0)
        self.spi.write(bytes((_WRITE, reg, val)))
        self.cs.value(1)

    def _read(self, reg, n):
        # One full-duplex transfer: command, address, then n dummy bytes while the chip
        # clocks the registers out on MISO (address auto-increments).
        tx = bytearray(2 + n)
        tx[0] = _READ
        tx[1] = reg
        rx = bytearray(2 + n)
        self.cs.value(0)
        self.spi.write_readinto(tx, rx)
        self.cs.value(1)
        return rx[2:]

    def read_raw(self):
        """(x, y, z, temp) raw counts from one burst read, so all axes are from the same sample."""
        d = self._read(_XDATA_L, 8)
        return (_s16(d[0], d[1]), _s16(d[2], d[3]), _s16(d[4], d[5]), _s16(d[6], d[7]))

    def acceleration(self):
        """(x, y, z) in g. 1 mg/LSB at +/-2 g, 2 mg at +/-4 g, 4 mg at +/-8 g."""
        x, y, z, _ = self.read_raw()
        k = _MG_PER_LSB[self.g_range] / 1000
        return x * k, y * k, z * k

    def temperature(self):
        """Approximate die temperature in degC from the datasheet's TYPICAL figures
        (350 LSB at 25 degC, 0.065 degC/LSB). Uncalibrated: the bias varies by
        +/-290 LSB part to part, so calibrate against a known temperature."""
        t = self.read_raw()[3]
        return 25 + (t - 350) * 0.065

example.code:
from machine import Pin, SPI
import time
from adxl362 import ADXL362

# SPI mode 0 (polarity=0, phase=0) as the ADXL362 datasheet requires
spi = SPI(1, baudrate=1000000, polarity=0, phase=0, sck=Pin({SCK}), mosi=Pin({MOSI}), miso=Pin({MISO}))
acc = ADXL362(spi, {CS})  # +/-2 g range: 1 mg per count
while True:
    x, y, z = acc.acceleration()
    print('X=%.3f Y=%.3f Z=%.3f g' % (x, y, z))
    time.sleep_ms(500)
